title: GLM_FORCE_SIZE_T_LENGTH fails with latest GLM (0.9.9.0)
body:

>         template<length_t L, typename T, precision P = defaultp> struct vec;
>                           ^
> /usr/local/include/glm/detail/../detail/type_mat.hpp:11:71: note: previous non-type template parameter with type 'int' is here
